title: Make all the KDE Clock styles available for the lockscreen and login windows
line: The lock screen and login screen settings now have a Clock style choice, Digital or Analog, and the analog clock uses the Plasma style's clock face.
explanation: The lock screen, the Breeze SDDM theme and Plasma Login Manager all use the shared Breeze Clock component, which could only draw a digital time and date, and none of them had a clock style option. Clock now has an analog property that draws the Plasma style's clock face and hands (the same widgets/clock SVG the Analog Clock widget uses) above the date, sized like the digital time so it fits wherever the digital clock fits. The lock screen Appearance page and the Login Screen Appearance page get a Clock style: Digital/Analog choice (disabled while the clock is hidden), and the SDDM theme reads an analogClock key in theme.conf.

commits.message:
lookandfeel/components: add an analog style to Clock

The lock and login screens could only show a digital clock, while the
panel offers other styles. Clock gains an analog property that draws the
Plasma style's clock face in the same space the digital time takes.

BUG: 459158

lockscreen, sddm-theme: allow showing an analog clock

The lock screen and the login screen theme always showed a digital
clock. The lock screen settings now have a Digital/Analog clock style
choice, and the SDDM theme reads a matching analogClock key.

BUG: 459158

kcm, greeter: allow showing an analog clock

The login screen always showed a digital clock. The Appearance page now
offers a Digital/Analog clock style choice next to Show clock, stored as
AnalogClock in the Greeter group, and the greeter follows it.

BUG: 459158

Subject: [PATCH] kcm, greeter: allow showing an analog clock

From eb45b58e8562570c799b71e79cace5bb275658ba Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:28:09 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lookandfeel/components: add an analog style to Clock

The lock and login screens could only show a digital clock, while the
panel offers other styles. Clock gains an analog property that draws the
Plasma style's clock face in the same space the digital time takes.

BUG: 459158
---
 lookandfeel/components/Clock.qml | 135 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 135 insertions(+)

diff --git a/lookandfeel/components/Clock.qml b/lookandfeel/components/Clock.qml
index d3d31d1683..56a858c4e6 100644
--- a/lookandfeel/components/Clock.qml
+++ b/lookandfeel/components/Clock.qml
@@ -11,13 +11,148 @@ import QtQuick.Layouts
 import org.kde.plasma.clock as PlasmaClock
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents3
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg
 
 ColumnLayout {
     id: root
 
+    property bool analog: false
+
     readonly property bool softwareRendering: GraphicsInfo.api === GraphicsInfo.Software
 
+    component Hand: KSvg.SvgItem {
+        id: hand
+
+        required property real svgScale
+        property real angle
+        property string rotationCenterHintId
+        property real horizontalOffset
+        property real verticalOffset
+        readonly property point rotationCenter: {
+            if (svg.hasElement(rotationCenterHintId)) {
+                const hintRect = svg.elementRect(rotationCenterHintId);
+                const handRect = svg.elementRect(elementId);
+                return Qt.point((hintRect.x - handRect.x + hintRect.width / 2) * svgScale,
+                                (hintRect.y - handRect.y + hintRect.height / 2) * svgScale);
+            }
+            return Qt.point(width / 2, width / 2);
+        }
+
+        width: naturalSize.width * svgScale
+        height: naturalSize.height * svgScale
+        x: parent.width / 2 - rotationCenter.x + horizontalOffset
+        y: parent.height / 2 - rotationCenter.y + verticalOffset
+        transform: Rotation {
+            origin.x: hand.rotationCenter.x
+            origin.y: hand.rotationCenter.y
+            angle: hand.angle
+        }
+    }
+
+    KSvg.Svg {
+        id: clockSvg
+        imagePath: "widgets/clock"
+    }
+
+    KSvg.SvgItem {
+        id: face
+
+        readonly property real svgScale: width / naturalSize.width
+        readonly property size shadowOffset: {
+            const offset = Qt.size(0, 0);
+            if (clockSvg.hasElement("hint-hands-shadow-offset-to-west")) {
+                offset.width = -clockSvg.elementSize("hint-hands-shadow-offset-to-west").width;
+            } else if (clockSvg.hasElement("hint-hands-shadows-offset-to-east")) {
+                offset.width = clockSvg.elementSize("hint-hands-shadows-offset-to-east").width;
+            }
+            if (clockSvg.hasElement("hint-hands-shadow-offset-to-north")) {
+                offset.height = -clockSvg.elementSize("hint-hands-shadow-offset-to-north").height;
+            } else if (clockSvg.hasElement("hint-hands-shadow-offset-to-south")) {
+                offset.height = clockSvg.elementSize("hint-hands-shadow-offset-to-south").height;
+            }
+            return Qt.size(offset.width * svgScale, offset.height * svgScale);
+        }
+        readonly property real hourAngle: 180 + timeSource.dateTime.getHours() * 30 + timeSource.dateTime.getMinutes() / 2
+        readonly property real minuteAngle: 180 + timeSource.dateTime.getMinutes() * 6
+        readonly property real secondAngle: 180 + timeSource.dateTime.getSeconds() * 6
+
+        visible: root.analog
+        svg: clockSvg
+        elementId: "ClockFace"
+        Layout.preferredWidth: timeLabel.implicitHeight
+        Layout.preferredHeight: timeLabel.implicitHeight
+        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
+
+        Accessible.role: Accessible.StaticText
+        Accessible.name: Qt.formatTime(timeSource.dateTime, Qt.locale(), Locale.ShortFormat)
+
+        Hand {
+            svg: clockSvg
+            svgScale: face.svgScale
+            elementId: "HourHandShadow"
+            rotationCenterHintId: "hint-hourhandshadow-rotation-center-offset"
+            horizontalOffset: face.shadowOffset.width
+            verticalOffset: face.shadowOffset.height
+            angle: face.hourAngle
+        }
+        Hand {
+            svg: clockSvg
+            svgScale: face.svgScale
+            elementId: "HourHand"
+            rotationCenterHintId: "hint-hourhand-rotation-center-offset"
+            angle: face.hourAngle
+        }
+        Hand {
+            svg: clockSvg
+            svgScale: face.svgScale
+            elementId: "MinuteHandShadow"
+            rotationCenterHintId: "hint-minutehandshadow-rotation-center-offset"
+            horizontalOffset: face.shadowOffset.width
+            verticalOffset: face.shadowOffset.height
+            angle: face.minuteAngle
+        }
+        Hand {
+            svg: clockSvg
+            svgScale: face.svgScale
+            elementId: "MinuteHand"
+            rotationCenterHintId: "hint-minutehand-rotation-center-offset"
+            angle: face.minuteAngle
+        }
+        Hand {
+            svg: clockSvg
+            svgScale: face.svgScale
+            visible: timeSource.trackSeconds
+            elementId: "SecondHandShadow"
+            rotationCenterHintId: "hint-secondhandshadow-rotation-center-offset"
+            horizontalOffset: face.shadowOffset.width
+            verticalOffset: face.shadowOffset.height
+            angle: face.secondAngle
+        }
+        Hand {
+            svg: clockSvg
+            svgScale: face.svgScale
+            visible: timeSource.trackSeconds
+            elementId: "SecondHand"
+            rotationCenterHintId: "hint-secondhand-rotation-center-offset"
+            angle: face.secondAngle
+        }
+        KSvg.SvgItem {
+            anchors.centerIn: parent
+            width: naturalSize.width * face.svgScale
+            height: naturalSize.height * face.svgScale
+            svg: clockSvg
+            elementId: "HandCenterScrew"
+        }
+        KSvg.SvgItem {
+            anchors.fill: parent
+            svg: clockSvg
+            elementId: "Glass"
+        }
+    }
+
     PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+        id: timeLabel
+        visible: !root.analog
         text: Qt.formatTime(timeSource.dateTime, Qt.locale(), Locale.ShortFormat)
         textFormat: Text.PlainText
         style: root.softwareRendering ? Text.Outline : Text.Normal
-- 
2.53.0
